legal.privacyBody:
Your vault stays on your device. Everything in it is encrypted with a key made from your main password, and it never reaches Qasa's server. We can't read it, and we can't reset your main password.

There's no sign-up: no name, email or phone number. Our server keeps only what it needs to run your account: a random account ID, your linked devices (name, type, language and, if you allow notifications, a push token), your plan and payments, and the notices we send you. Payments happen on Wayl's page; we never see your card or wallet details.

The breached-password check sends only the first 5 characters of each password's hash, straight to Have I Been Pwned. Wi‑Fi sync goes directly between your devices. No ads, no analytics, no trackers, and we never sell your data.

Backups are encrypted files you save where you choose, such as iCloud Drive or Google Drive. They go there straight from your device, never through our server, and open only with your main password. You can also export your vault to CSV at any time, and delete your account, with everything our server holds about you, in Settings or by asking us.

Full policy: qasa-app.com/privacy
